configurations.//: Both ports are fixed on purpose, so autoPort must stay false. The API's CORS allowlist hardcodes http://localhost:5173 (see backend/src/lib/origins.ts), so a frontend on any other port has every request rejected; and frontend/.env points VITE_API_URL at http://localhost:8787, so the API moving breaks the same link from the other end. Free the port rather than reassigning it.
